description: ECAS 写单个事件簇完整流水线 (替代 write-chapter)。1 个 cluster = 1 个 ME 大势事件 = 8K-16K 字 → splitter 切 N 章 → 每章独立 audit + voice-keeper → cluster 级 cross-chapter scan + save-state per chapter.

steps.name: research-first
steps.description: .7 调研先行 + ECAS 硬约束: spawn novel-researcher 调研本 cluster 主题 (TASK_TYPE=outline + SCOPE 按 cluster parent_me 类型选)。输出 .research_cache/cluster_<id>_<topic>_<时间>.md，所有 anchor 必须 ≥1 source URL。后续 step 2 outline-planner / step 3 writer 必须 RESEARCH_REF 字段引用此 cache。

steps.name: load-cluster-brief
steps.description: 读 _数据库/事件簇.json 中本 cluster_id 的 brief + 验证字段完整 (cluster_id / parent_me / scope_summary / expected_word_range / mid_checkpoints / foreshadowing_to_plant)

steps.name: build-manifest-with-event-cluster
steps.description: build_manifest.py 注入 event_cluster_context 字段 (从 事件簇.json 提取)。本步用当前 cluster 的第一章号生成 base manifest (后续每章可微调)

steps.name: spawn-writer-ecas-mode
steps.description: spawn novel-writer MODE=ecas + cluster_id + 自适应字数。writer 内部自动跑 mid-checkpoint × 3 + sub-summary 锚定。如 cluster.opus_recommended=true → 用 Opus 4.7 + Extended Thinking

steps.name: checkpoint-validation
steps.description: save_state.py --ecas-checkpoint <cluster_id> 验证 writer 完整草稿: 1) 字数 in expected_word_range; 2) sub_summaries 完整; 3) mid_checkpoint_results 全 passed

steps.name: spawn-splitter-multi-chapter
steps.description: spawn novel-chapter-splitter MODE=ecas_multi_chapter + cluster_id + TARGET_CHAPTERS=cluster.estimated_chapters。按 .6 三机制 + N 章联合优化

steps.name: split-cluster-changes-to-per-chapter
steps.description: 从 cluster_<id>_changes.json 按 splitter 切点拆出 N 个 ch_NNN_changes.json (各章带 ecas_metadata.cluster_position)

steps.name: per-chapter-validator-repair
steps.description: 每章独立跑 spawn novel-validator-repair (≤3 轮)。N 章并行 spawn (独立 prompt context)

steps.name: per-chapter-audit-hub
steps.description: 每章独立跑 audit_hub.py + --waivers。verdict 必 in (pass/waived/auto_fixed) 才进 step 9

steps.name: per-chapter-voice-keeper
steps.description: 每章 spawn novel-voice-keeper 重审 (新增: 与 cluster 内其他章对比一致性)

steps.name: cluster-level-cross-chapter-scan
steps.description: 新增: 簇内一致性 / 节奏 / 伏笔覆盖率 / hub 分布。复用现有 18 cross_chapter_scanner 但 scope=cluster

steps.name: per-chapter-save-state-and-summarizer
steps.description: 每章独立 save_state + spawn novel-summarizer + spawn novel-foreshadower

steps.name: cluster-reflector-and-auto-post-reflect
steps.description: spawn novel-reflector (cluster 级 + 章级双层) → save_state --auto-post-reflect 每章。新增 cluster_pattern_extractor (簇级共性)
scripts: for ch in ch_range: python core/scripts/save_state.py {project_root} --auto-post-reflect {ch}

steps.name: world-evolution-apply-cluster
steps.description: world_evolution_engine apply_cluster (簇级 tick)。fate_engine 标记 ME_to_advance 已完成

steps.name: git-commit-cluster
steps.description: Git commit 整 cluster (合并所有 N 章 + cluster_draft + cluster_changes) 单 commit message 含 cluster_id + ME + N 章信息

steps.name: generate-next-cluster-card
steps.description: spawn novel-outline-planner MODE=ecas_cluster_brief 生成下个 cluster 候选 + 写入 事件簇.json + dashboard 报告

_quality_gates.mid_checkpoint_failures_max_3: writer 内 mid-checkpoint 失败 ≤ 3 否则 fallback Opus 重写整簇
_quality_gates.research_first_required: ECAS cluster brief 前必跑 novel-researcher; cluster brief.research_ref 字段必填
